english_text: I thank the President-in-Office for his answer . But , after all , it is also the Council which is competent for countries outside our European Union and especially for a question which has political connotations . My question is simply : has the Council been informed about the changing attitude in Switzerland ? It is not the first time this has happened . Recently it has happened several times . Would it not be useful to inform the Swiss authorities that they should inform their own people that there has been such an agreement made with the Commission ?
